data.name: Ra'Uf
data.gender_notes: Ra'Uf is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who is gentle and kind to others, having a peaceful nature. The name Ra'Uf carries the meaning “Gentle, Kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ra'Uf usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A companion of Allah, a merciful and gentle soul.
data.etymology: Ra'Uf belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ra'Uf total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: رعوف
in_arabic.long_meaning: رعوف من أسماء الله الحسنى، يعني الرحيم الرؤوف بالعباد، الذي يرعاهم ويرحمهم ويعطف عليهم، وقد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في عدة آيات، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَرُسُلًا كَذَّبْنَاهُم مِّن قَبْلُ ۚ لَم يَأْتِ مِثْلَ مَجِيئِهِنَّ وَلَوْلَا إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ زَعَمَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَنَّ هَذَا إِفْكٌ مُّبِينٌ'

in_urdu.name: رعوف
in_urdu.meaning: رعوف مطلب رحیم اور رؤف بالعباد
in_urdu.long_meaning: رعوف اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، جس کا مطلب رحیم اور رؤف بالعباد ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں بہت مقبول ہے اور اسلامی تقالید میں اس کی اہمیت ہے۔ اس کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں بھی آیا ہے، جیسے کہ 'وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالِمِينَ'

in_hindi.name: रऊफ
in_hindi.meaning: रऊफ मतलब रहिम और रउफ बलेवाडा
in_hindi.long_meaning: रऊफ अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक है, जिसका अर्थ रहिम और रउफ बलेवाडा होता है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है और इस्लामी परंपरा में इसकी महत्ता है। इसका उल्लेख कुरआन मजीद में भी आया है, जैसे कि 'وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالِمِينَ'

in_pashto.name: رعوف
in_pashto.meaning: رعوف د رحیم او رؤف بالعباد معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: رعوف د الله ښو نومونو څخه یو دی، چې د رحیم او رؤف بالعباد معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې ډیر مشهور دی او په اسلامي دودیزو کې یې اهمیت لري. دا نوم په قرآن کریم کې هم ذکر شوی، لکه 'وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالِمِينَ'

in_english.name: Ra'Uf
in_english.meaning: Ra'Uf means The Merciful, The Kind
in_english.long_meaning: Ra'Uf is one of the beautiful names of Allah, meaning The Merciful, The Kind. It is derived from the Arabic root 'R-ʿ-F' which connotes the idea of mercy and compassion. The name Ra'Uf has been mentioned in the Quran, emphasizing the attribute of divine mercy and kindness towards servants. It holds significant spiritual meaning and cultural importance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing a person's character traits such as empathy and benevolence.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ra'Uf holds significant cultural importance in the Islamic community due to its excellent meaning, which reflects the moral values and virtue taught in Islam. Ra'Uf's gentle and kind nature symbolizes the Mercy and Compassion of God towards His creations. The Islamic Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) advised Muslims to be gentle, just, and kind to others, and the name Ra'Uf embodies this noble character trait.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Ra'Uf reminds us of the importance of being kind to others and maintaining a peaceful disposition in our interactions. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "Your Lord is gentle and loving." (Bukhari and Muslim) As Muslims, we strive to be close to our Creator by emulating His attributes, and the gentleness and kindness embodied in the name Ra'Uf helps us demonstrate this spiritual devotion. Therefore, the name Ra'Uf holds spiritual significance as a reminder of the importance of being gentle, kind, and compassionate, both towards others and towards ourselves. Embracing this name can be an excellent motivation to lead a more virtuous and peaceful life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Gentle, Kind" symbolizes A person who is gentle and kind to others, having a peaceful nature.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ra'Uf serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of gentle, kind.
